observations.body: Moses asks to see glory; the LORD promises goodness and name, says no one may see his face and live, and places Moses in a rock cleft to see his back.
observations.label: Moses asks to see glory and is protected from the face

observations.body: The calf, judgment, intercession, threatened absence, and restored presence remain one damaged sequence without being collapsed into an easy resolution.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 33:18–23 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Moses asks to see glory and is protected from the face belongs to the breach and intercession movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
